facts.fact: The BCEAO told every bank, e-money issuer and payment institution in the eight WAEMU countries, Senegal included, to be connected to PI-SPI by 30 June 2026, and on 25 June 2026 moved the deadline to 30 September 2026, with 30 June 2027 for microfinance institutions.

systems.tiers: banks, e-money institutions, payment institutions, microfinance institutions
